examples.text: Convert this list of names into alphabetical order: Zara, Michael, Amina, Devon, Priya.
Rewrite the following sentence in passive voice: The technician repaired the printer this morning.
Convert these temperatures from Fahrenheit to Celsius: 98.6, 32, 212.

Reformat this run-on sentence into two shorter sentences: The meeting started late because the projector wasn't working and nobody could find the remote so we had to reschedule the demo for the following day.
Turn this paragraph into a numbered list of the three steps it describes: First you preheat the oven, then you mix the dry ingredients, and finally you fold in the wet ingredients before baking.
Convert this date from US format to European format: 03/14/2026.
Rewrite this sentence to remove all contractions: I don't think we'll make it, but we can't be sure yet.
Reformat this comma-separated list into a bulleted list: apples, oranges, bananas, grapes.
Convert this measurement from miles to kilometers: 26.2 miles.
Rewrite this title in title case: the quick fox and the lazy dog.
Reformat this phone number into the standard XXX-XXX-XXXX format: 5551234567.
Convert this currency amount into a plain number without the dollar sign: $1,250.00.
Rewrite this sentence in the past tense: She walks to the store every morning.
Reformat this key-value text into a simple list: name is Alex, age is 29.
Convert this 24-hour time to 12-hour format: 14:30.
Rewrite this list in reverse order: one, two, three, four, five.
Reformat this address onto a single line: 123 Maple Street, Springfield, IL, 62704.
Convert this fraction to a decimal: 3/8.
Rewrite this sentence so it starts with Although: The flight was delayed, we still arrived on time.
Reformat this list of numbers in ascending order: 42, 7, 19, 3, 88.
Convert this Celsius temperature to Fahrenheit: 100.
Rewrite this heading in sentence case: HOW TO BAKE BREAD AT HOME.
Reformat these bullet points into a single paragraph: wake up early, exercise, eat breakfast.
Convert this weight from pounds to kilograms: 150 lbs.
Extract the shipping address from this text: John Smith, 42 Baker Street, London, NW1 6XE, United Kingdom.
Pull out all the dates mentioned in this paragraph: The project kicked off on March 3rd, had a checkpoint on April 15th, and is due to wrap up by June 1st.
Extract the total amount due from this invoice text: Subtotal $340.00, Tax $27.20, Total $367.20.
Find the email address in this text: For questions, please reach out to support@examplecorp.com during business hours.
